note: Original paper and author's pinned GitHub repository checked; the executable LeRobot plugin and Apache-2.0 source license are public. Model checkpoints of comparison VLAs are third-party, and no independent evaluation was run.

code.note: Runnable LeRobot policy plugin, memory-building and evaluation scripts released with original README.

weights.note: Not yet independently audited in VLA-Radar.

dataset.note: Not yet independently audited in VLA-Radar.

training.note: No trainable kNN policy for ResNet and multimodal variants; a learned LAC linear projection and calibration/tuning code are provided; Optuna validation uses some official evaluation initial states.

inference.note: Out-of-tree LeRobot kNN policy with retrieval, action chunk mixing and optional temporal ensembling.

evaluation.note: LeRobot LIBERO evaluation and 420-variant LIBERO-Plus setup with source protocol described; repository release does not certify independent reproduction.

license.note: The source repository declares Apache 2.0; separate third-party dataset and checkpoint rights apply.
